t: Town of Ryegate
s: Ryegate has a population of 223 and was named from a field of rye on the Sims-Garfield Ranch. It is situated in a sheltered spot below rims on the north and Musselshell River to the south. The town was first settled in 1910 as a Milwaukee Railroad Town, incorporated in 1917 and named County seat of Golden Valley County in 1920 when the County was formed.
